scope: Level 60 Night Elf, Bonereaver's Edge; 51 points, at least 31 Fury and Bloodthirst, no Protection. Preserve the original preset's buffs, nonweapon gear, enchant types, fight settings and cooldown/consumable schedules.
objective: Mean of individual fights' DPS. UI damage / duration is also reported.

search.talents: Multistart eight-member beam search, followed by one-point transfers alternating with ability searches. Arms/Fury damage and rage talents; canonical filler choices omit irrelevant utility, offhand-only talents and Protection.
search.abilities: Three conditional passes through all ordered subsets of eligible attacks in normal phase (13,700 with Spearing Strike; 1,957 without it), and 1,957 execute-phase subsets per pass. Rage thresholds, main-ability cooldown restrictions, after-swing Slam, Heroic Strike and Berserker Rage toggles; subsequent talent neighborhoods and finer thresholds.
search.validation: Selection frozen before three nonoverlapping seed blocks; 1,500,000 fights per comparison.
search.limitations: Conditional and local search, not an exhaustive global optimum. Consumable/cooldown schedules were fixed. Small differences between closely matched configurations can be sampling noise.

rotation.name: Elune’s Light
